about: Mix-and-match sections for dental practices (general, cosmetic, orthodontic), chiropractors and physiotherapy/rehab clinics, from 12 Dribbble full-page references (1–12.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg. Real photos of the team, the treatment rooms and (consented) patients carry these pages; fall back to clean clinical stock. Ratings, patient counts, years, insurance logos and before/after results must come from FACTS.
